Join Howard University and thrive with us!
 Purpose
The successful candidate will play a critical role in the design, synthesis, and characterization of novel nanomaterials for drug delivery applications, as well as the development of advanced chemical biology tools. This individual will be responsible for applying expertise in nanoparticle production, fluorescent labeling strategies for biomolecules, and robust bioconjugate synthesis to advance our pipeline of innovative therapeutics and diagnostics.
Supervisory Authority
This position may involve supervising undergraduate and graduate students.
Nature And Scope
Internal contacts include Jacqueline Smith. External contacts include N/A.
Principal Accountabilities
The Research Scientist will be responsible for the following.
  • Design, synthesize, and characterize various types of nanoparticles (e.g., liposomes, polymeric nanoparticles, inorganic nanoparticles) for targeted drug delivery, gene therapy, or diagnostic imaging applications.
  • Optimize nanoparticle formulation parameters (size, morphology, surface charge, drug loading, release kinetics) for desired in vitro and in vivo performance.
  • Develop and implement robust analytical methods for nanoparticle characterization (e.g., DLS, TEM, SEM, HPLC, UV-Vis, fluorescence spectroscopy).
  • Evaluate the stability, biocompatibility, and efficacy of nanoparticle-based systems.
  • Develop and optimize strategies for site-specific and quantitative fluorescent labeling of peptides, proteins, antibodies, and other biomolecules.
  • Work with a variety of fluorescent dyes and fluorophores, including organic dyes, quantum dots, and fluorescent proteins.
  • Characterize labeled biomolecules for purity, integrity, and functionality using techniques such as gel electrophoresis, mass spectrometry, and fluorescence spectroscopy.
  • Design and execute synthetic routes for the efficient and reproducible conjugation of various molecules (e.g., drugs, targeting ligands, imaging agents) to nanoparticles, peptides, proteins, and other biomolecules.
  • Utilize a range of bioconjugation chemistries (e.g., click chemistry, amide coupling, maleimide chemistry, hydrazone formation) to achieve desired conjugation outcomes.
  • Purify and characterize bioconjugates using appropriate chromatographic and spectroscopic methods.
  • Design and synthesize novel small molecules, linkers, and probes for various biological applications.
  • Presenting research findings at regular group meetings, as well as local and national conferences
  • Publishing findings in peer-reviewed journals
Core Competencies
  • Extensive hands-on experience with the synthesis, characterization, and application of various nanoparticle systems for drug delivery (e.g., liposomes, polymeric nanoparticles, micelles, dendrimers).
  • Proficiency in a wide range of analytical techniques for nanoparticle characterization (e.g., DLS, TEM, SEM, cryo-TEM, HPLC, FPLC, UV-Vis, fluorescence spectroscopy, zeta potential).
  • Demonstrated expertise in diverse bioconjugation chemistries (e.g., EDC/NHS, maleimide-thiol, click chemistry, hydrazone, oxime ligations).
  • Proven ability to design and execute strategies for fluorescent labeling of peptides, proteins, and other biomolecules.
  • Strong background in organic synthesis and purification techniques (e.g., column chromatography, HPLC, LC-MS).
  • Solid understanding of biomolecular interactions and protein chemistry.
  • Proficiency in data analysis software and scientific literature databases.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a commitment to scientific rigor.
Minimum Requirements
M.S. in Chemical Biology or Biochemistry and 1-2 years of experience or Ph.D. Chemical Biology or Biochemistry

title: Center Director, PANAFTOSA
description:
Overview

Grade: P-5

Salary - Annually: Step I - 101,540.00 USD

Post Adjustment - Annually: 30,563.54 USD

Contractual Agreement: Staff - Professional Post

Job Posting: September 4, 2025

Closing Date: September 25, 2025, 11:59 PM Brasilia Standard Time

Primary Location: Rio De Janeiro, Brazil

Organization: AFT Centro Panamericano de Fiebre Aftosa (PANAFTOSA)

Schedule: Full time

Description of Duties / Organizational Context

The incumbent is responsible for the management of the Pan American Foot-and-Mouth Disease Center and Veterinary Public Health (PANAFTOSA), providing leadership on the principles and implementation of PAHO’s technical cooperation on Veterinary Public Health and One Health. The incumbent promotes the applications of One Health good practices and is responsible for the management and administration of the Center’s human and financial resources and fixed assets. He/she must maintain a harmonious and effective collaboration with counterparts in national and international administrations, and non-government, philanthropic, academic and private organizations, from the public health, agriculture and animal health sectors. The incumbent should cultivate and maintain a close professional relationship with Brazilian Authorities, particularly those related to the operation and maintenance of the Center, in accordance with the Agreement signed by the Government of Brazil with PAHO for the Center. The incumbent follows broadly stated guidance in terms of policy and mission of the Organization and has the authority to establish guidelines of major importance on programmatic activities and Center’s management and administration operations to address problems that might require complex considerations and alternative possible solutions, involving internal and external stakeholders. The incumbent acts as prime advisor of the Organization to discuss problems and seek solutions on VPH and One Health policy issues in direct coordination with the Assistant Director in the area of One Health. The incumbent will be responsible for the VPH and One Health component of the PAHO Strategic Plan and Biennial Work Plans, within the framework of the policy orientations and mandates of the Governing Bodies.

Summary of Responsibilities

Under the direct supervision of the Director, Communicable Diseases and Environmental Determinants of Health (CDE) and the general supervision of the Assistant Director (AD), the incumbent is responsible for the following duties:

  • Lead the Organization’s technical cooperation on Veterinary Public Health (VPH) for the elimination of Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD), food safety and antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in the food of animal origin value chain, and the prevention, control/elimination of zoonotic and foodborne diseases and envenomation in the Americas, consistent with the One Health approach.
  • Direct, manage, plan, organize, implement and evaluate programs necessary to achieve the aims and objectives of the Center’s technical cooperation, including field interventions, research, training and dissemination of information.
  • Provide technical expertise and lead the normative function of the Organization regarding food safety and control/elimination of FMD and zoonotic diseases in collaboration with partners, academia, ministries of health, ministries of agriculture, and other stakeholders.
  • Advise and promote inter-programmatic work across the Organization to ensure efficient use of resources and alignment with biennium work plans and strategic priorities.
  • Lead and direct the management and administration of the Center, ensuring alignment with the Strategic Plan, Biennial Work Plans, UNDSS security requirements, and business continuity planning.
  • Direct and guide technical cooperation for strengthening national and international disease information and surveillance systems on FMD, and foodborne and zoonotic diseases.
  • Direct technical cooperation for strengthening national laboratories and international laboratory networks, including training programs and coordinating reference services.
  • Oversee the Organization’s WOAH Reference Laboratory on FMD and WOAH Collaborating Center on Veterinary Public Health.
  • Mobilize human and financial resources in support of national programs and cooperate with member states in designing and evaluating project proposals.
  • Serve as the Secretary of COSALFA and REDIPRA, including planning and managing meetings and presenting at international events.
  • Provide leadership to staff in a multicultural environment, mentor supervised staff, set objectives, conduct performance reviews, and promote staff development.
  • Promote ethical behavior and integrity in line with PAHO’s Code of Ethical Principles and Conduct.
  • Provide a stable managerial framework and advise Member States’ institutions in the area of expertise.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Key Behavioral Competencies

Overall attitude at work: Maintains integrity, ethical approach, and accountability; respects colleagues and counterparts.

Respecting and valuing individual differences: Treats everyone with dignity and respect; avoids stereotypes; considers others’ perspectives.

Teamwork: Fosters collaboration across the Organization, builds partnerships, and maintains an effective network.

Communication: Articulates strategic objectives, adapts to audiences, and shares knowledge and directives effectively.

Creating an empowering and motivating environment: Provides direction, motivates teams, and promotes autonomy and high performance.

Ensuring effective use of resources: Sets measurable objectives, allocates resources, and monitors progress.

Driving the Organization to a successful future: Leads with vision, fosters a culture of long-term goals, and rewards progress.

Technical Expertise

  • Technical: Extensive senior experience in managing complex human/animal health programs at national and international levels; strong knowledge of public and animal health, veterinary public health, surveillance, and evidence-based advisory capabilities.
  • Managerial: Senior management experience in large administrations; proficiency in health administration, international legislation, negotiation, and organizational development.
  • Administrative: Resource mobilization, financial management, and administration platforms for Finance, Budget, HR, and Infrastructure; ability to handle confidential information.

Education (Qualifications)

Essential: University degree in veterinary medical science, and a master’s degree in public health, veterinary public health, animal health, veterinary epidemiology, or related field from an accredited institution.

Desirable: Doctoral degree in a public health or animal health-related area.

Experience

Essential: Thirteen years of progressively increased responsibilities in national and international management, with experience designing, planning, executing, and evaluating technical cooperation related to public and animal health; involvement in international technical cooperation programs and activities in veterinary public health and One Health; experience with FMD, food safety, zoonoses, and epidemiological surveillance at the international level.

Languages

Very good knowledge of English and Spanish with a working knowledge of another language. Knowledge of Portuguese and/or French would be an asset.

IT Skills

Demonstrated ability to use current technology and software, ERP and management information systems; proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, OneDrive, PowerPoint, Teams, Visio, SharePoint and Project is an asset.

Disclaimer & Application Details

  • All applicants are required to complete an online profile to be considered for this post.

  • Candidates will be contacted only if they are under serious consideration.

  • Assessment of credentials can be performed via listed sources: World Higher Education Database (WHED), Council for Higher Education Accreditation (CHEA), and College Navigator (NCES).

Overview

O Ton é uma empresa do grupo Stone Co., focada em empoderar empreendedores autônomos por meio de soluções financeiras como maquininhas, conta digital, cartão e programa de renda extra. Nosso time é apaixonado por desafios e movido por impacto real na vida dos nossos clientes — sempre com leveza, autonomia e muita colaboração. Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar com um time de apaixonados por desafios, sempre preocupado em atender da melhor forma os nossos clientes e buscando as melhores escolhas técnicas para entregar os resultados. E mais importante, tudo isso em um ambiente descontraído com horário flexível e a possibilidade de trabalhar remoto.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

A equipe do programa Renda Extra | TON está dedicada a transformar vidas por meio de oportunidades únicas de geração de renda. Nosso programa oferece uma maneira inovadora para os nossos parceiros, de obter uma renda adicional ou até mesmo substituir sua fonte de renda principal sem nenhum vínculo empregatício. Nosso objetivo é empoderar as pessoas, proporcionando-lhes os meios para alcançar a estabilidade financeira e crescimento pessoal.

Senior Software Engineer Node

Você terá um papel essencial na evolução do nosso ecossistema, atuando no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, provas de conceito e melhorias contínuas nos nossos microsserviços e aplicações. Esperamos que você contribua ativamente desde a ideação até a entrega, participando de cerimônias, revisando código, mantendo e atualizando a documentação técnica. Fará parte de um time colaborativo, engajado em criar soluções escaláveis e de alto impacto, sempre em alinhamento com os padrões técnicos da companhia. Aqui, valorizamos opiniões, ideias novas e iniciativas — queremos que você protagonize melhorias e ajude a elevar a barra técnica do produto. Também é esperado que você compartilhe conhecimento com o time, lidere refatorações quando necessário, e participe ativamente do refinamento de demandas junto ao time de UX, garantindo entregas com qualidade e foco no cliente.

O que esperamos de você

  • Experiência com NodeJS, TypeScript e Jest
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura moderna: SOLID, Clean Architecture, FaaS, APIs REST/WebSocket
  • Prática com AWS (Lambda, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, S3 etc.) e banco NoSQL (DynamoDB)
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de cache e busca (Redis, OpenSearch/ElasticSearch)
  • Git, CI/CD, documentação técnica e segurança em desenvolvimento

O que aumenta as suas chances

  • Experiência Banco de Dados relacional
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de infraestrutura em código, como Terraform
  • Habilidade de otimização para suporte de alto volume de dados
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade e monitoramento como DataDog, CloudWatch e Splunk
  • Experiência com automação de Testes e testes de carga (Jest, K6, JMeter)

Benefícios

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico
  • Hospital Digital, da Vitta: com equipe médica 24/7
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação
  • Auxílio Remoto + Setup Inicial (para vagas remotas)
  • Horário flexível
  • Benefício Educação - Plataforma interna com livros, podcasts, treinamentos e videoaulas
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Vale Transporte (exclusivo para vagas presenciais)

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

  1. Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco. Nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve.
  2. Entrevistas com o time de People: papo para conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio proposto.
  3. Avaliação Técnica: aprofundar hard skills com possibility de dois papos ou um desafio.
  4. Check de Cultura: conversa com guardiões da cultura para alinhar crenças e visão.
  5. Feedback: compartilharemos o feedback independente do resultado.
  6. E aí? Curtiu? Inscreva-se e #VemSerStone

Overview

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.

*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub! We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a B2B Analytics Senior Manager to our Marketing Operations team in Brazil ! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

The B2B Insights Senior Manager will join our global Marketing Operations team, with a primary focus on the US B2B market. In this role, you will be responsible for generating strategic insights that shape our global approach while also delivering deep, localized analysis to accelerate growth in the US. You will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders across marketing, sales, and operations, translating complex data into clear business narratives that drive decision-making. This is a great opportunity for a senior professional who combines strategic vision with hands-on analytical expertise, bringing a consultative mindset to help Wellhub strengthen its data-driven marketing capabilities and expand its impact in the B2B space.

Your Impact

  • Accelerate US Growth: Accelerates growth in the US by providing granular, market-specific insights, enabling the US marketing team to make smarter, faster decisions, improving campaign performance, lead generation, and revenue contribution. You will serve as the dedicated data partner for the US revenue marketing team, uncovering deep, localized insights from granular data to drive targeted initiatives and inform strategic decisions for this key market. The role involves navigating the pressures of the US market and coordinating with marketing, sales operations, and sales.
  • Drive Global Strategy: Analyzes macro-level trends and performance benchmarks that inform and optimize our global marketing strategy, leading to more efficient spending and a stronger market position.
  • Data & Reporting: Collects and analyzes data from sources such as data lake, HubSpot, Salesforce, Web Analytics, Paid Media, etc., to produce analyses for global and US needs. Ensures accurate tracking of key marketing KPIs (Traffic, MQLs, Conversion Rates, etc.) and translates complex data into reports and presentations for stakeholders.
  • Innovation: Identifies, evaluates, and advocates for AI-powered tools and innovative solutions to improve data analysis and understanding of the B2B ecosystem.
  • Live the mission: Inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

Who You Are

  • Academic Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Analytics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  • Data & Analytics Expertise: Strong foundation in data analysis, including statistical analysis, A/B testing methodologies, and attribution modeling.
  • B2B Marketing Acumen: Understanding of the B2B lead-to-revenue funnel, including metrics, lead scoring, and customer lifecycle stages.
  • Technical Proficiency:
    • Experience with Marketing Automation platforms like HubSpot and Marketo
    • Experience with CRM like Salesforce
    • Proficiency in BI tools like Tableau or Looker
    • Proficiency in data manipulation languages like SQL and Python is a plus
  • Professional Experience:
    • Previous senior-level experience in a marketing analytics, business intelligence, or marketing operations role
    • B2B experience is mandatory, but not specific in marketing
    • International experience is a plus
  • Languages: Fluent English is mandatory

Ao integrar nossos 4 pilares, Estratégia, Projetos e Produtos, Processos e Operações e Pessoas, apoiamos nossos clientes para atingirem melhores resultados com #qualidade #foco #produtividade.

Se você deseja trabalhar em uma empresa reconhecida pela qualidade, agilidade, que preza pelo respeito e tem uma cultura de integração, inclusão e diversidade, temos um lugar para você no nosso time #SouDC. Somos uma empresa GPTW (Great Place to Work).

Buscamos um Scrum Master Sênior experiente para integrar a equipe do nosso cliente que é líder em seu segmento e gerenciar projetos desafiadores.

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Gerenciar times multidisciplinares ágeis formados para acelerar a evolução de produtos de software, visando o atingimento de resultados e benefícios acordados com a organização.
  • Atuar constantemente na identificação de gargalos do time, propor plano de melhoria e ganhos de produtividade através de ciclos de PDCA.
  • Aplicar metodologias ágeis, incluindo Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, Scrum of Scrum, visando potencializar o resultado do time com as entregas.
  • Apurar métricas e indicadores que mensurem claramente o progresso físico dos entregáveis, como burndown, burnup, velocidade, dentre outros.

  • Colaborar com o Product Owner, apoiando o planejamento do produto, construção de roadmap, storyboard/User Story Mapping, definição/priorização do Backlog. Orientar sobre a construção de User Stories.
  • Atuar com pares e liderança para remover impedimentos que comprometam o resultado das sprints.
  • Atuar na condução de ritos de imersão como Inception e dinâmicas de refinamento funcional e técnico.
  • Apresentação executiva detalhada do status report do resultado da esteira e progresso dos principais épicos e entregas.
  • Resolução de conflitos, facilitar discussões para resolver conflitos e promover a colaboração.
  • Apoiar o gestor no controle financeiro do squad, revisando custo planejado e apurando realizado para controlar saldo financeiro.
  • Facilitar e organizar cerimônias e rituais requeridos para o progresso das entregas.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Certificação Scrum Master (CSM), PMI-ACP, Professional Scrum Master (PSM).
  • Formação em TI, Engenharia, Administração e áreas afins.
  • Conhecimentos intermediários sobre processos e procedimentos de engenharia de software, necessários para produção de produtos de software e sistemas.
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos comprovada com práticas ágeis, liderando times ágeis.
  • Vivência em projetos de desenvolvimento de software (aplicativos, portais, produtos digitais, soluções de IA operando de forma integrada com sistemas de gestão como Salesforce e SAP).
  • Conhecimento em métodos e práticas ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, Canvas, Scrum of Scrum).
  • Experiência com indicadores de performance de produtividade de times e esteiras.
  • Experiência com utilização de conceitos Lean Agile.
  • Experiência com apresentações executivas.
  • Experiência anterior com ferramentas para a organização do trabalho (Azure e/ou Jira).

Necessário disponibilidade para viagens e residir em outros estados.
